articles.title: Xi Jinping delivers speech at commemoration of 105th anniversary of CPC founding
articles.summary: Xi Jinping delivered remarks at a commemoration meeting marking the 105th anniversary of the Communist Party of China's founding.

articles.title: Xi Jinping presents promotion certificates to two military officers with rank of general
articles.summary: Xi Jinping, as Chairman of the Central Military Commission, presented promotion certificates to two military officers, Zhang Shuguang and Wang Gang, advancing them to the rank of general.

articles.title: Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building provides new approach for global party governance, report indicates
articles.summary: A research center report indicates that Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building offers a new framework for political party governance worldwide.

articles.title: Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building opens new horizons in Marxist party construction theory, report states
articles.summary: A research report states that Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building has advanced Marxist theory of party construction with a people-centered approach and scientific methodology.
